summary: A black sci-fi 'spaceship' page for a family whose slant runs from −45° Retalic to +45° Italic: the hero is a cockpit HUD (gauges, pilot, 'Buckle in' ticker) around a canvas hyperspace warp with flying slanted titles, then pointer- or tilt-driven axis demos, two scroll-driven 3D wireframe tunnels, Lottie diagrams of construction details, colour-coded slant matrices, and a full-screen cockpit-console type tester with animated presets. A fixed bar with a context 'message centre' changes its prompt per section.

instances.look: A cockpit HUD frames the screen (top status 'GT PLANAR ENG PXS VEC SNR NFO', red 'BUCKLE IN TO ENSURE PILOT SAFETY' ticker, red EXIT button, side gauges ENG, BAT, VEC, TLT, bottom PXS dial, MOD waveform, pilot portrait with FOCUS/OXYGEN/AWAKE bars, SNR radar) around a black starfield warp where 'TYPE THE FINAL FRONTIER' and 'GT PLANAR −45° +45°' fly at the viewer with every letter at a different slant
instances.ux: Stars accelerate into hyperspace on load; title planes zoom forward in sequence; HUD gauges read live values (scroll distance in px, tilt %, battery, pointer vector puck); 'EXIT' or the 'HUD' toggle hides the cockpit and reveals the page; the HUD can be re-opened from the fixed bar anywhere
instances.learn: Turn the scroll position and pointer into instrument readouts: a themed HUD makes ordinary browsing feel like piloting

reconstruction.layout: Full viewport 1440×900; HUD fixed: top bar 70px (status block ~300px, ticker, EXIT ~60px red square), left and right gauge columns ~100px, bottom console ~150px with dials and pilot panel; canvas fills the rest; title centred, 3 lines (~146px)
reconstruction.typography: Title GT Planar wght 500, uppercase, per-letter slnt stepping −25…+25 across each word (e.g. T −25, Y −8.33, P 8.33, E 25), white; HUD labels ~12px GT Planar caps; 'GT Planar' 40px Medium
reconstruction.behaviour: Canvas starfield with radial streaks (warp); intro planes (intro__plane--first) scale/translate in Z with an intro--enter class; HUD widgets hud__battery, hud__speedo, hud__tilt, hud__vec-puck, hud__distance-text, hud__tape-counter update from scroll and pointer; ticker scrolls; site loads from white → HUD boot (~2s)
reconstruction.content: Star Trek pastiche ('Type: the final frontier', 'Buckle in to ensure pilot safety')
reconstruction.assets: Pilot portrait image, HUD SVG gauges
reconstruction.html: section[data-component=intro] > canvas[data-component=intro__canvas] + .intro__plane > span per letter with font-variation-settings; div[data-component=hud] with hud__* components

instances.look: 'LIFTOFF' label at left and a 6-line white paragraph at right on black ('Welcome to a galaxy of Uprights and Italics built as one…'), with a few slanted letters mixed in
instances.learn: Keep the space metaphor in the copy ('Swiss Futurism', 'galaxy of Uprights and Italics') so the prose matches the theatrics

reconstruction.layout: Content column x=250–1190; label in the first third, paragraph spanning the right two thirds (~620px), ~320px tall
reconstruction.typography: ~24px GT Planar Light (wght 300), white, leading ~1.3; label ~14px caps; individual letters at slnt 39 inside the text
reconstruction.content: Real description: seamless Thin–Black and −45° Retalic to +45° Italic, Dominik Huber, 'welcome to Swiss Futurism'

instances.variantDefinition: The pointer's x and y position over the sample or the whole viewport (or device tilt on touch) each drive one variable axis, with edge tracks or labels showing the axis and its live value; no sliders to grab
instances.look: 'Bending / the laws / of nature' huge in white inside a frame with corner crosses, an 'ANGLE: 0°' puck on a top track and a vertical 'WEIGHT: 0' puck on the left track
instances.ux: Moving the pointer left–right bends the text from −45° to +45° and up–down changes weight, the pucks sliding along their tracks with live values; on touch devices a red 'Pilot needs to activate tilt mode' button requests device-motion permission so tilting the phone drives the axes; the fixed bar says 'move mouse'
instances.learn: Map slant to horizontal pointer movement: the gesture literally leans the text, so the axis is understood by the body

reconstruction.layout: Framed area 940×705 in the content column; text centred, 3 lines; top track along the frame's top edge with a small bordered puck; left track along the left edge with a rotated puck; 16px plus-sign images at the corners
reconstruction.typography: Text 19vw mobile / ~187px desktop, GT Planar slnt −45…45, wght 100–900, white, leading 0.9; puck labels ~11px caps
reconstruction.behaviour: pointermove → slnt from x, wght from y (or DeviceOrientation after request-motion permission); puck translate follows; values written into the puck labels
reconstruction.content: A claim about the font ('Bending the laws of nature')

instances.look: A large outline 'a' drawn as a fan of stacked contours sweeping from red (Retalic) through yellow to green (Italic), then 'BEYOND DIVISIONS' and two text columns
instances.feel: Like a long-exposure photo of a letter
instances.ux: Lottie animation draws the stepped contours; static text
instances.learn: Overlay every slant step of one letter in a colour ramp: the continuous axis becomes one image

reconstruction.layout: Lottie full content width (~940×300) on top, then a 3-column row: caps label, two ~300px text columns
reconstruction.typography: Outline 'a' ~400px drawn at slnt −45…+45; body ~17px GT Planar Light white; label ~14px caps
reconstruction.behaviour: lottie-player aa_web.json / aa_mobile.json (draws the contour fan)
reconstruction.content: Real note: Retalic to Upright to Italic as one continuous design space
reconstruction.assets: Lottie JSON of the slant fan

instances.look: A top row of seven angle labels (RETALIC 45/30/15 in red, orange, yellow, UPRIGHT in green, ITALIC 15/30/45) above two columns of weight names 'Thin … Black' in pale green, each in its weight
instances.ux: The pointer's horizontal position selects one of the seven angles: the weight names slant to it and take that angle's colour; on touch, tilt mode drives it
instances.learn: Colour-code the angle steps (red at the extremes, green upright) so slant reads as a temperature scale

reconstruction.layout: Label row across the 940px column; 6 rows of two right/centre-aligned words, ~120px rows; hidden indicator spans track the pointer
reconstruction.typography: Words ~115px GT Planar wght 100/250/400/550/750/900; labels ~11px caps in #fe003c, #ff8a00, #fcff76, #00ff85
reconstruction.behaviour: pointermove x → slnt step (−45, −30, −15, 0, 15, 30, 45) and colour on all rows

instances.look: A purple wireframe tunnel in one-point perspective with red slanted words 'A NEW' and 'SYSTEM' on its ceiling, floor and walls; at the end the 'DESIGN' paragraph
instances.feel: Flying through a vector grid, 80s sci-fi
instances.ux: Pinned for 450vh: scrolling moves the camera down the tunnel (translateZ), word planes pass by, and the DESIGN text arrives from the vanishing point; message centre reads 'Traverse infinity'
instances.learn: Use scroll as forward motion through a CSS 3D tunnel and place the copy at its end: the reader 'arrives' at the statement

reconstruction.layout: Sticky inner 200% wide (-50% margin), height 100vh, scroll height 450vh; planes at --offset −1350, −900, −450px along Z (--tunnel-length 1350px); grid lines drawn as borders
reconstruction.typography: Wall words text-4xl/8xl GT Planar caps, red, letters at slnt 25 → −25, vertical writing-mode on the walls; DESIGN paragraph ~24px Light white
reconstruction.behaviour: scroll progress → --tunnel-translate translateZ on .ss__tunnel; perspective on .ss__inner
reconstruction.content: 'A NEW SYSTEM' and the real design paragraph ('GT Planar provides a program pushed and not constrained by its exceptions…')

instances.look: Six Lottie diagrams on black, each with a caps heading and short text: a zoom with a scrambling 'SCALE 36565%' counter into an outline 'Straight' with red hatched joints (STRAIGHT CURVES), purple 'ET' with point markers and angle labels (FLEXIBLE PERSISTENCE), outline 'run' with green spur markers (CALCULATED SURPRISES), solid purple slanted 'ace' (EXPRESSIVE CONTROL), outline 'ECONOMIC' filling letter by letter (DYNAMIC PACE), outline 'SPACE' with hatched counters and area labels (BALANCING ACT)
instances.ux: Animations play as they enter; message centre says 'Stay focused'; the scale counter and scrambled text decode on scroll
instances.learn: Draw letters as outlines and hatch only the detail under discussion (joint, spur, counter): the eye goes straight to the decision

reconstruction.layout: Mostly 8+4 grid: Lottie 8 columns (~620px) beside heading + text 4 columns, alternating; full-width diagrams (ECONOMIC, SPACE) above a 3-column text row; ~3100px total
reconstruction.typography: Diagram letters ~200–300px GT Planar in outline or solid purple; annotation labels ~10px in red boxes; headings ~14px caps white; body ~17px Light
reconstruction.behaviour: lottie-player straight_web, kreis_web (zoom), et_web, run, ace, economic_web, space_web (and _mobile versions); scramble-text component counts SCALE up and scrambles a word
reconstruction.content: Real design notes: horizontal terminals stay horizontal at any angle, spurs stay vertical, hand-drawn italics narrow at extreme angles, steady capitals, counters shifted to top and bottom

instances.look: A second, longer tunnel in red wireframe with purple 3D blocks lettered 'THE', 'FUTURE', 'ROOTED', 'IN' sliding past, ending on 'FUTURE CLASSIC — Expressive rationalism. Vivid discipline. Playful determination.'
instances.ux: Pinned for 750vh; scrolling flies through the tunnel, blocks pass on the floor and walls; text revealed at the end
instances.learn: Reuse the same scroll mechanism with a new colour and longer length for the closing statement: repetition becomes a chapter marker

reconstruction.layout: Same structure as the first tunnel with --tunnel-length 2250px and --scroll-height 750vh; blocks are purple panels with caps words on the tunnel faces

reconstruction.behaviour: scroll → translateZ; ss__tunnel-block elements with font-variation-settings
reconstruction.content: 'The future rooted in…' and the Future Classic paragraph

instances.look: A ruled white-on-black matrix: columns −45° … +45° (labels red, orange, yellow, green, yellow, orange, red) × rows THIN … BLACK (rotated labels), each cell a letter pair ('Aa', 'Bb' …) at that slant and weight
instances.ux: Hovering a cell tints it with its angle colour (data-color); message centre reads 'Explore quadrants'
instances.learn: Lay out a slant axis left-to-right with upright in the middle: the table itself looks like the letters are leaning

reconstruction.typography: Pairs ~58px GT Planar at slnt −45…45, wght 100…900; headers ~10px caps in angle colours

instances.look: 'FAMILY OVERVIEW' intro: 'Download all 42 trial font files…' beside a solid neon-green 'DOWNLOAD FREE TRIAL FONTS' button; an outlined green 'DOWNLOAD PDF SPECIMEN' button sits in the character-set intro; 'Buy' lives in the fixed bar

instances.variantDefinition: Ligatures, alternates or special glyphs set inside a display sentence or lockup and picked out in an accent colour, so they are discovered in context rather than in a catalogue
instances.look: 'STYLISTIC ALTERNATES': a run of space-themed specimen items in neon green and purple ('SPACE GEEKS', 'Celestial Coordinates? Galactic & Ecliptic…', 'galactic guardian', 'Pulsar is a magnetized rotating neutron star…', three columns on Kepler and Newton, '2.6907 1,3514?'), letters with alternates picked out in the other colour, each item tagged 'WEIGHT 900 · ANGLE +00' and 'STRAIGHT / SINGLE STORY / CURVED ALTERNATES ON'
instances.ux: Each item's On/Off indicator flips (hover or loop) to swap the highlighted letters between default and alternate forms; message centre reads 'Galaxy of alternates'
instances.learn: Colour only the letters that have alternates and label the set and its state above the sample: the reader sees exactly what the feature changes

reconstruction.behaviour: span.letter-with-alt get the alternate (ss01–ss04) when the item's indicator is On; specimen-ot-alt-indicator-active/inactive swap
reconstruction.content: Astronomy copy with real facts (Kepler 1609–1619, Newton 1642–1726, orbit definitions)

instances.look: A sticky isometric wireframe cube whose three visible faces show the current glyph ('W') at −30° in red, 0° in green and +30° in purple, beside pale-yellow bordered grids labelled BASIC LATIN, EXTENDED LATIN, ALTERNATE CHARACTERS, NUMBERS – PUNCTUATION – SYMBOLS
instances.ux: Hovering a grid cell puts that character on all three cube faces at three slants; message centre reads 'Zoom zoom zoom'
instances.learn: Show the inspected glyph on the faces of a cube at three angles: the inspector demonstrates the slant axis at the same time

instances.look: A full-screen blue-on-black cockpit console (HTML only): one auto-fitted editable line ('MAY THE FORCE BE WITH YOU'); top bar with AUTO PILOT play/stop, PRESETS DEF · STA · DOM · BOU · IMP · ENE · R_0, a message centre and HUD / TEST / BUY switches plus EXIT; bottom bar with POWER STEERING, FEATURES toggles (Flat Shapes Alts ss04, Curved Numbers ss03, Single Story Alts ss01+ss02), an ANGLE speedometer with readout (+27) and buttons 0°, ±15°, ±30°, ±45°, and a WEIGHT selector (Thin…Black) with readout (423) and notched slider
instances.ux: Opened from 'TYPETESTER' in the fixed bar; type to replace the text (auto-fit); presets apply choreographed per-letter animations of slant and weight (e.g. bounce, domino, impulse); Auto Pilot loops through settings; Power Steering likely hands the axes to pointer/tilt; on mobile a vertical weight slider and a slant slider
instances.learn: Give a tester named presets that animate letter by letter: one click shows what the axes can do in motion, then the visitor takes the controls
